world.beach.npc.greeting: Hey there, dude! I'm Surfer Sam. This beach is full of mysteries. Waves, boards, sand, fish... What do you wonder about?

world.beach.starter.wave.q2: Why do waves crash on the beach?

world.beach.starter.sun.q1: Why do I burn faster at the beach?
world.beach.starter.sun.q2: Why does the land warm up first?
world.beach.starter.sun.q3: How can I stay safe in the sun?
world.beach.starter.fish.label: Fish
world.beach.starter.fish.q1: How do fish float without sinking?
world.beach.starter.fish.q2: Why do things float better in the sea?

world.beach.starter.wind.label: Wind
world.beach.starter.wind.q2: Why does wind blow from the sea?
world.beach.starter.wind.q3: Does stronger wind make bigger waves?
world.beach.recall.prompt: Why does a foam surfboard float?
world.beach.recall.c1: Foam is lighter than water for its size
world.beach.recall.c2: Waves hold it up from below
world.beach.recall.c3: It is heavy, so it sits on top
